{{Quote|Captain—Before we die... I just want you to know something... I've always hated you.|Number Two's last words to [[Captain Cautious]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 23">[[Star Wars (1998) 23|''Star Wars'' (1998) 23]]</ref>}}
'''Number Two''' was the callsign of the second in command aboard [[Captain Cautious's freighter]]. He disliked working under [[Captain Cautious]] and regularly complained about him to his colleagues. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] during a routine freight job he was killed when the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] he was on was destroyed by the [[Infinity Gate]] above the planet [[Ova]]. His last action was to inform the captain how much he hated him.
